I'm Victor Osimen. A product designer and AI builder who turns startup ideas into live, working products, without a single line of code. I use Webflow and AI-powered tools to design, build, and ship at a pace most teams can't match.

Over 3 years, I've worked across fintech, real estate, and SaaS, designing products that handle real money, real users, and real pressure. As co-founder of ContentSplitHQ, I've built from zero to live and know what it takes to get a product out of Figma and into the world.

If you need someone who thinks like a designer, moves like a builder, and stays until the product ships, that's exactly what I do.
